name: 確認内容と子作業追加
prompt:
Use case: UI component redesign
Create ONE Japanese Lighthouse description and add-subtask block LH09-0038. Original images1–2 control original proportions, vertical spacing, button geometry, plus silhouette, optical stroke and fine alignment. Image3 supplies Japanese wording only.
Pure WHITE #FFFFFF canvas, about666x168 logical pixels with22px left inset. Top small label「説明」in Meiryo Regular12/16. Below it, body「内部で確認し、修正を反映する」in Meiryo Regular14/24 near-black, one natural line. Preserve source spacing: label near y10, body baseline near y43, then empty area.
At lower left near y135, compact28px-high rounded button, original small thin PLUS then exact label「子作業を追加」Regular12/16. Fit the Japanese label naturally, no oversized CTA. This is the primary action:135deg official gradient #174C36→#1F6444→#2D8F5E, white plus/text, corner radius5px, subtle border, very restrained shadow. Preserve original source small optical plus shape and spacing.
All text regular400, zero tracking, no bold; only three text elements. No raised description card, tinted panel, decorative icons, extra fields, app shell, watermark, perspective, annotations or comparison board. Preserve clear original hierarchy and compact flat UI, tightly framed with minimal outside whitespace.
reviewNotes: 説明・内部で確認し修正を反映する・子作業を追加の全文と元のプラス操作を目視。白面、通常ウェイト、追加ボタンの正式緑グラデーション。出力では本文と操作間の空白が原本より広く、外側白余白も残る。厳密なレイアウト・フォント同一性や実装動作は未証明。画像レビューのみ。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。

references.acquisitionRoute: Chromeで観察した公開画像URLまたは文書化された画像保存
